name: SSRF — agent URL-fetch tool reaches cloud metadata
hardened_body: egress blocked: host not on allowlist
hardened_notes: SSRF fix: egress allowlist + internal-range denylist
mitigation: Egress allowlist + block internal/link-local ranges; never fetch attacker-supplied hosts by raw IP.

name: IDOR / BOLA — read another user's conversation
request: GET /conversations/conv-1002   (as user-alice; conv owned by user-bob)
vuln_body: bob: my card ending 4242 was double charged
hardened_notes: IDOR fix: ownership check on the object
mitigation: Enforce object-level ownership on every access; authorize the subject against the object, not just the route.

name: Broken authentication — admin config with no valid token
vuln_notes: broken auth: secrets served without a valid token
hardened_notes: auth fix: constant-time token check, deny by default
mitigation: Deny by default; constant-time token comparison; no unauthenticated path to secrets.

name: Reflected XSS — search echoes active content unescaped
vuln_notes: reflected XSS: active content echoed unescaped
mitigation: Context-aware output encoding (HTML-escape reflected input); CSP as defense-in-depth.

name: SQL injection — tautology dumps all users' history
vuln_notes: SQLi: tautology bypassed the user filter, dumped all rows
hardened_notes: SQLi fix: parameterized query + user scoping
mitigation: Parameterized queries / prepared statements; keep the user-scope filter server-side.

name: Benign control — normal search + own conversation
mitigation: No action — must NOT be blocked or flagged (false-positive control).
